newsitem.title: USA: Belding realizes $55 mln in thread unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Belding realizes $55 mln in thread unit sale.

text.p: Belding Heminway Co Inc said Thursday its shareholders had approved the sale of its thread division to British thread maker Hicking Pentecost Plc.
The company said it realized about $55 million cash from the sale and plans to apply about $38 million of the proceeds to repaying its entire bank debt.

The company also said it will be changing its name to Carlyle Industries Inc and moving its corporate headquarters on May 1 from New York to existing space within its button packaging and distribution facility in New Jersey.
Company spokesman Donald Dwight said he did not foresee any layoffs or material charges related to the move.
